content: We have mass spec showing m/z 180.0423 as base peak (intensity 100). Likely molecular ion M+ at 180.0423. That suggests molecular formula maybe C9H8O4 (mass 180.0423). Indeed aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid) is C9H8O4, exact mass 180.0423. So likely aspirin. Need SMILES: "CC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O". Let's verify with formula tool? Could get formula from SMILES.
